design_rules: The Obsidian design vault (C:/Users/newte/Documents/Design Wiki) is the authority for design reasoning. Before placing any part, read its COTS record under 'Projects/MC3 Collimator/04 Records/COTS/'. A part with no COTS record does not go in the schematic.
Controlled values (rail voltages, current limits, board outline, connector geometry) come from PARAM records in the vault. Cite the PARAM; never invent a value in the KiCad project.
Assembly house is JLCPCB. Every placed part carries its JLCPCB part number (LCSC C-number) from its COTS record as a field, and uses a footprint from the project-local MC3_COL_MAIN library.
Per-part layout constraints (bypass adjacency, Kelvin pairs, thermal vias, keep-outs) live in docs/design/parts/<part>.md in this repo; read them before placing or routing that part.
